subject.title: [Bug]: Google Chat: Space/Group messages silently ignored (DMs work correctly)

question: Should Google Chat Space mention gating add a BOT-annotation fallback, require explicit `botUser` with stronger diagnostics, or use another app-identity contract for mentioned Space messages?
rationale: Source review proves the remaining drop path, but the repair changes how OpenClaw decides a Space message is meant for this app, which has multi-bot and false-positive implications.

options.title: Approve Safe Mention Repair
options.body: Add a plugin-local mention detector that handles current `USER_MENTION` annotations, keeps explicit `botUser` authoritative, rejects ambiguous multi-bot cases, logs actionable drops, and proves it with live Space evidence.

options.title: Require Explicit Bot User
options.body: Keep `botUser` as the only non-`users/app` identity contract and improve setup/doctor/log diagnostics so users can recover without guessing.

options.title: Consolidate Into Broader Routing Work
options.body: Move the remaining mentioned-Space ingress requirement into a broader Google Chat routing/auth plan, leaving this issue open until that canonical plan is explicit.

recommendation.title: Approve Safe Mention Repair
recommendation.body: Add a plugin-local mention detector that handles current `USER_MENTION` annotations, keeps explicit `botUser` authoritative, rejects ambiguous multi-bot cases, logs actionable drops, and proves it with live Space evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current history on the Google Chat ingress/access-policy and mention-gating code that needs the product decision.
